info.title: mcgill.courses
info.description: A course search and review platform for McGill University.

get.description: Complete the Microsoft OAuth flow and establish a session for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code issued by Microsoft.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque state returned by Microsoft and used for redirect validation.

303.description: Redirect to the original post-login location.

500.description: Failed to exchange the authorization code or create the session.

get.description: Redirect the requester to initiate the Microsoft OAuth flow.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Absolute URL to send the user back to after sign-in completes.

303.description: Redirect to the Microsoft login page.

get.description: Invalidate the current session and redirect the user back to the client.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Absolute URL to send the user to after logout.

303.description: Redirect to the requested post-logout location.

get.description: Get course grade averages by term.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: Filter by course ID.

get.description: Get a list of courses with optional filtering.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of course levels to filter by.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of courses to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of courses to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query string to filter courses by title, description, or ID.

parameters.name: sortReverse
parameters.description: Whether to reverse the sort order. When true, sorts descending (highest first).

parameters.name: sortType
parameters.description: Field to sort results by.

parameters.name: subjects
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of subject codes to filter by.

parameters.name: terms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms to filter by.

parameters.name: with_course_count
parameters.description: Whether to include the total course count in the response.

get.description: Get information about a specific course by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Course ID in the format {SUBJECT}{CODE} (e.g., COMP202, MATH240). Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: with_averages
parameters.description: Whether to include grade averages in the response.

parameters.name: with_reviews
parameters.description: Whether to include reviews in the response. Reviews are sorted by timestamp, newest first.

404.description: No course exists with the given ID.

get.description: Get information about an instructor along with their reviews.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Instructor name to retrieve information for.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's interaction kind for a review.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: Course ID to get the interaction for.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User ID of the review author.

200.description: Authenticated user's interaction kind for the requested review.

post.description: Record a new interaction for a course.

delete.description: Remove an interaction for a course.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's interactions for a course.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: Course ID to get interactions for.

200.description: Authenticated user's interactions for the requested course.

get.description: Get the current user's notifications. Returns notifications for reviews on courses the user is subscribed to, sorted by most recent first. Requires authentication.

200.description: Notifications for the authenticated user, sorted by recency.

put.description: Mark a notification as seen or unseen. The notification is identified by the course ID and the ID of the user who created the review. Requires authentication.

requestBody.description: Notification identifier and the new seen status.

delete.description: Delete a notification for the current user. The notification is identified by the course ID and the ID of the user who created the review. Requires authentication.

requestBody.description: Notification identifier specifying which notification to delete.

get.description: Get a list of reviews with optional filtering by course, instructor, or user.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: Course ID to filter reviews by (e.g., COMP202).

parameters.name: instructor_name
parameters.description: Instructor name to filter reviews by. Must match exactly.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of reviews to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of reviews to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: sorted
parameters.description: Whether to sort reviews by timestamp (newest first).

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User ID to filter reviews by.

parameters.name: with_user_count
parameters.description: Whether to include the count of unique users who have submitted reviews.

put.description: Update an existing review for a course. The review is identified by the authenticated user's ID and the course ID. Updates the timestamp and associated notifications.

requestBody.description: Updated review data. All fields are required even if unchanged.

post.description: Add a new review for a course. A user can only have one review per course. Instructors must be valid for the course or 'Other'. Creates notifications for users subscribed to the course.

requestBody.description: Review data including course ID, rating, difficulty, instructors, and content.

delete.description: Delete a review for a specific course. Also removes all associated interactions (likes) and notifications. The review is identified by the authenticated user's ID and the course ID.

requestBody.description: The course ID of the review to delete.

200.description: Review and associated data deleted successfully.

get.description: Get all reviews that the authenticated user has liked. Returns a list of full review objects. Requires authentication.

200.description: Reviews liked by the authenticated user. The unique_user_count field is always null for this endpoint.

get.description: Get a specific review by its unique identifier. The review includes interaction data (likes) specific to the authenticated user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique review identifier. This is a MongoDB ObjectId string.

200.description: The requested review with user-specific interaction data.

404.description: Review with the specified ID was not found.

get.description: Search for courses and instructors matching a query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query string.

200.description: Search results for courses and instructors.

get.description: Get all subscriptions for the authenticated user.

200.description: List of subscriptions for the user.

delete.description: Delete a subscription for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get a specific subscription for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: Course ID to fetch a subscription for.

200.description: The requested subscription, or `null` if not found.
